PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Software engineer with 6 years of experience building Python services and React applications for operations teams. Seeking a Senior Software Engineer role focused on backend services, reliable delivery, and practical collaboration with product partners. Comfortable translating written requirements into maintainable code, reviewing changes, and supporting services after release.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer | Cedar Systems | Austin, Texas
September 2022 - August 2026
- Developed Python and FastAPI services backed by PostgreSQL for inventory management and shipment tracking. Worked with product managers to define acceptance criteria and document API contracts for internal consumers.
- Built React and TypeScript screens that let operations staff search orders, correct incomplete records, and review shipment history. Added accessible forms, loading indicators, and clear validation messages.
- Used Docker and AWS to package and deploy services. Maintained GitHub Actions workflows for automated builds, unit tests, and deployment checks. Investigated failed releases and documented recovery steps.
- Improved SQL queries used by daily operational reports. Added indexes after reviewing query plans, reduced duplicate database calls, and verified that totals matched existing financial exports.
- Wrote pytest tests for data validation, authorization, and retry behavior. Reviewed pull requests with an emphasis on readable code and preserving existing customer workflows.
- Participated in an on-call rotation, investigated production incidents, and added structured logs and dashboards to make recurring failures easier to diagnose. Shared incident findings with the team.

Junior Software Engineer | Willow Analytics | Austin, Texas
September 2020 - August 2022
- Implemented Django endpoints and PostgreSQL migrations for an internal reporting application. Coordinated releases with analysts who relied on the reports during weekly planning meetings.
- Wrote Python scripts to validate incoming CSV files, flag duplicate records, and produce error summaries. Added regression tests for missing columns and inconsistent date formats.
- Updated JavaScript interfaces, fixed browser compatibility issues, and worked with designers to improve keyboard navigation. Maintained documentation for common support requests.
- Used Git for version control and Linux for development and troubleshooting. Paired with senior engineers to review requirements and break larger changes into smaller releases.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Texas at Austin
August 2016 - May 2020
Coursework included data structures, algorithms, databases, operating systems, and software engineering. Completed a team project that exposed a REST API and a web interface for scheduling community events.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Python, FastAPI, Django, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Git, GitHub Actions, Linux, pytest, REST API, HTML, CSS.

PROJECTS
Community Events Scheduler: Developed a Python API and React interface for event registration. Implemented input validation and PostgreSQL storage, wrote setup instructions, and collected feedback from volunteer coordinators.
Data Quality Toolkit: Created Python utilities for checking CSV exports before loading them into reporting tables. Included automated tests, sample inputs, and documentation explaining each validation rule.
